not_a: This is not a court-ready dossier, a legal finding, or an accusation. It records what the system computed and under which assumptions.

rank_fragility.coverage_note: Single-axis and two-axis perturbations only. Three-or-more-axis combinations were not tested, so absence of a flip is evidence of stability across the tested set, not a proof of stability.
rank_fragility.interpretation_note: A sensitivity counterfactual, not proof of causal responsibility. Grid win frequency is an evidence score, not a calibrated probability of responsibility.

limits: Synthetic contacts from a stand-in detector, not a validated ship detector on real SAR. The rates measure the matching and coverage logic, not detection quality.
A source vessel may have left the scene before acquisition. Same-scene ship detection cannot recover a contact absent from the image; the correct output in that situation stays unknown source.
These are simulated hiding experiments. They are not evidence about real intentional non-broadcasting by any vessel.
Neighbouring broadcast density is a weak proxy for reception quality; sparse traffic cannot establish good or bad coverage.

forward_exposure.forcing_mode: reanalysis-style retrospective field — NOT an operational forecast issued from fields available at issuance time
forward_exposure.interpretation_note: Modelled surface-particle exposure and arrival intervals under the tested forcing ensemble. Not a prediction of beaching, concentration, or environmental damage. Weathering, emulsification and shoreline interaction are not modelled.

next_observation.method_note: Simple footprint-disagreement score between the two leading hypotheses under the nominal forcing variant. Not expected information gain: no observation likelihood and no prior over hypotheses are modelled.
next_observation.scope_note: The system recommends which evidence would be informative. It does not task satellites and does not assert that an acquisition is available in the recommended window.

uncertainty_statement: Rankings express physical consistency under tested assumptions. They are not proof of responsibility.
Ensemble and perturbation-grid win frequencies are evidence scores, not calibrated probabilities. No calibration against held-out real outcomes exists.
Where no candidate clears the absolute fit gate the system reports unknown source rather than naming the least-bad option.
Synthetic ranking accuracy is not a measurement of real-world attribution accuracy.
checksum_note: Hashes verify file integrity only. They do not establish that an observation is true, that a label is correct, or that this analysis is legally sufficient.
